requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the early morning, the mist outside the mountain gate had not yet dispersed."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yun Zhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I brought three bags, all from the best in the back mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The ward cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep all night."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Before his words fell, Wanqi Jing rushed up from the foot of the mountain."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Panting, he said, a young woman was lying on the roadside at the foot of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Quick, lift her up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wanqi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the main hall, the iron plaque at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The injuries aren't serious; it's just that her spiritual power is depleted. Give her a Spirit Recovery Pill."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Senior Sister Wanqi, Elder Qin asked you to go to the ward; I and Senior Brother Wanqi are here."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Okay. Miss Qiu has woken up, come call me immediately."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wanqi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Xie Xuan stood at the palace entrance, his sword unsheathed, but the lights flickered for a moment."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qin, it has been a while. I come under the阁主's orders to take three-tenths of the qi stones."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three parts? The qi stones are what the sect has worked hard to save up; when is it outsiders' turn to take them?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "The ward is already cracked; it's not safe to leave the qi stones in your hands. I will come again in three days."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Xie Xuan sneered, turned, and left without looking back."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I always keep my word."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at Chou Shuang, who was sleeping on the couch."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Elder, let me guard the ward. Miss Qiu has Yue Chuan to look after her, so I can leave."}, {"id":1, "text": "Finally, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "This is the formation eye token. Only by guarding it can you be said to have guarded your path."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yue Chuan tucked the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's embrace and whispered a few more instructions."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "At the mountain gate, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Qiu has woken up, and she sends her thanks to you."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Shan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation eye token close to his chest."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "It's good that you're awake. You were unconscious all day, don't move around ▼"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking out at the cracked sky outside the window." }, {"id": 1, "text": "Unnoticed, the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal."}]}

translations.1: In the early morning, the mist outside the mountain gate had not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister Wanqi, Elder Qin asked you to go to the ward; I and Senior Brother Wanqi are here.
translations.11: Okay. Miss Qiu has woken up, come call me immediately.
translations.12: Wanqi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Xie Xuan stood at the palace entrance, his sword unsheathed, but the lights flickered for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, it has been a while. I come under the阁主's orders to take three-tenths of the qi stones.
translations.15: Three parts? The qi stones are what the sect has worked hard to save up; when is it outsiders' turn to take them?
translations.16: The ward is already cracked; it's not safe to leave the qi stones in your hands. I will come again in three days.
translations.17: Xie Xuan sneered, turned, and left without looking back.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at Chou Shuang, who was sleeping on the couch.
translations.2: Yun Zhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me guard the ward. Miss Qiu has Yue Chuan to look after her, so I can leave.
translations.21: Finally, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the formation eye token. Only by guarding it can you be said to have guarded your path.
translations.23: Yue Chuan tucked the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's embrace and whispered a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Qiu has woken up, and she sends her thanks to you.
translations.26: Shan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation eye token close to his chest.
translations.27: In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: It's good that you're awake. You were unconscious all day, don't move around ▼
translations.29: Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking out at the cracked sky outside the window.
translations.3: I brought three bags, all from the best in the back mountain.
translations.30: Unnoticed, the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The ward cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep all night.
translations.5: Before his words fell, Wanqi Jing rushed up from the foot of the mountain.
translations.6: Panting, he said, a young woman was lying on the roadside at the foot of the mountain.
translations.7: Quick, lift her up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills.
translations.8: Wanqi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the main hall, the iron plaque at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang.
translations.9: The injuries aren't serious; it's just that her spiritual power is depleted. Give her a Spirit Recovery Pill.
